fact: The communications minister said a facility information system is running in a number of hospitals, with 369 medical files registered at Al-Nau hospital and over 570 at Dhara hospital for oncology, and that a national digital health strategy was launched.
title: 230 خدمة صحية إلكترونية.. السودان يخطط لبناء منظومة صحة رقمية متكاملة
